basis: Malignant transformation of an eccrine sweat-gland tumour; cutaneous adnexal origin despite its breast location.
Meningeal tumour in the middle cranial fossa; skull location does not establish skeletal involvement.
Alcohol-induced lipid accumulation in hepatocytes defines this liver disease.
Tumour arises in gastric mucosa; possible associated Zollinger-Ellison syndrome does not establish additional organ damage.
Cardiac and skeletal features define Noonan syndrome; ptosis 14/16; cutis laxa/hyperkeratosis each 4/7. Coagulation abnormalities omitted at cap; developmental delay 2/13.
Hair and nail dystrophy define the disease; cleft palate/lip frequent (30-79%). Pinna shape and conjunctival redness do not establish functional damage.
Umbrella for inherited peptide metabolism defects; no additional damaged organ is established across most subtypes.
Microphthalmia with callosal/hippocampal malformations and developmental delay; cleft lip/palate in 1/1 reported patient. Frequencies rest on a single case.
Goniodysgenesis and intellectual disability define eye and neurodevelopmental involvement; short stature alone does not establish skeletal or endocrine damage.
Distal skeletal myopathy with weakness, amyotrophy and abnormal muscle histology; cardiac damage is not established for this specific subtype.
Lower motor neuron degeneration; persistent denervation causes skeletal muscle atrophy in 4/5 patients. Respiratory involvement is very rare.
Congenital ventricular outflow and septal malformations; pulmonary stenosis denotes a cardiovascular lesion.
Peroxisome biogenesis defect; developmental impairment, cataracts and hearing loss are common in reported PEX11B disease (each roughly >=30%); small cohorts.
Inherited recurrent gestational trophoblastic disease confined to reproductive and obstetric organs; no qualifying axis involvement.
Hypocellular marrow and cytopenias define marrow failure; osteopenia, hypothyroidism and tongue carcinoma each reported in only 1/4 patients.
Malignant neoplasm occupying the rectosigmoid bowel; lymphoma is only one possible histology within this umbrella.
Glutathione synthesis defect with hemolytic anemia; neuropathy/tract degeneration and myopathy each 80-99% in supplied HPO. Aminoaciduria alone does not establish renal damage.
Otic capsule remodelling causes conductive or mixed hearing impairment; localized ear disease.
Femoral head osteonecrosis and epiphyseal disease; local ischemic bone injury does not establish a separate vascular disorder.
Benign epithelial tumour of the ovarian surface; reproductive origin without endocrine dysfunction.
Glial tumour arising in brain or spinal cord; ocular involvement belongs to particular subtypes.
Neuroendocrine tumour arising in the esophagus; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Childhood movement disorder with dystonia, tremor and variable developmental impairment; isolated pneumothorax reporting does not establish common pulmonary damage.
Infertility from abnormal sperm morphology and absent acrosomes; purely reproductive dysfunction without endocrine organ disease.
Anemia defined by reduced red blood cell volume; no additional organ damage follows across this umbrella.
